column2: [intro]
I'm a pop singer, a little wild and free,
Always ready to make you laugh, that's me.
Critics and gossip? I don’t care at all,
I’d rather spread joy, that’s my call.
Controversy doesn’t interest me,
I just want to sing, that’s the key.
Forget the squabbles, let’s set them free,
Let our music shine, let it be.
My audience, you’re my one true delight,
I want to make you dance, day and night.
Discords and debates, such a waste,
I’d rather rhyme love and music with taste.
Controversy doesn’t interest me,
I just want to sing, that’s the key.
Forget the squabbles, let’s set them free,
Let our music shine, let it be.
[ solo ]
Come on, everyone, let’s raise our hands,
Sing non-stop, let the echoes expand.
Controversy has no place in our land,
Long live the music, long live the joy, that’s grand!
[outro]
